jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer (all genders)
jobs.desc: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior QA Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible . We live remote-first within Germany, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations. Contabo serves 180,000+ customers worldwide across VPS, dedicated servers, object storage and a growing cloud-native platform. Quality isn't a bottleneck function here – it's embedded in how we build. You'll work across multiple development teams on products that vary significantly in architecture, maturity and risk profile. The scope is wide and the technical surface is real. QA here means jumping between contexts and figuring things out, not just executing scripts against a stable codebase. You come in before development starts: read the requirements, flag what's untestable and push back early. You own the test strategy and update it as things change – not as a document exercise, but because the products actually change. You write test plans and test cases, run manual tests (functional, regression, exploratory, UAT) and build and maintain automated tests across UI, API and integration. We use AI tools actively: in development, in testing, in how we work day to day and we expect the same from you. That's not a trend we're chasing: it's how we stay fast without cutting corners on quality. You keep the continuous testing pipelines running and help the teams use them. When bugs come up, you write bug reports that developers can actually work with – reproduction steps, impact, everything needed to close it without a follow-up ping. Regular regression cycles after major releases are part of the job, as is running UAT with product stakeholders. What convinces us Your personality, paired with: 5+ years in software testing/QA, ideally in agile teams Test automation in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; hands-on with frameworks like Playwright, Frisby, or Supertest Experience using AI-assisted tools in development or testing (AI code generators, LLM-based test support or similar) and comfortable using Claude (or comparable LLMs) as part of your daily workflow Solid grasp of test design, QA processes, and translating requirements into test plans and test cases API testing (REST), Git, bug tracking, browser DevTools – these are daily tools for you Comfortable prioritizing across multiple test streams simultaneously Fluent English skills and German language skills would be a plus Experience with AI-assisted tools in testing or development UAT facilitation, QA process ownership, performance/integration testing We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. Awesome Prospects At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference. What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. Additionally, we offer: Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget How to reach us If you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by email at alina.peissl . jobs.desc: p strong About the job /strong /p p Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. nbsp; /p p As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren t readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence. /p p You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements. /p p Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics. /p p You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known. /p p nbsp; /p p strong The team and culture /strong /p p The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together. /p p We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don t all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems. /p p You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other. /p p One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are. /p p nbsp; /p p strong What we re looking for /strong /p ul li Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools. /li li Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. /li li A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems. /li li Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence. /li li Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams. /li li Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure /li /ul p While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. We actively welcome applications from engineers to the profession through a returnship or after a career break. /p p nbsp; /p p strong Benefits /strong /p ul li Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility /li li Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work /li li Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension /li li Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success /li li Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day /li li Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones /li li Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover /li li Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn /li /ul p We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. /p p We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. /p p nbsp; /p p strong Sponsorship /strong /p p Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. /p p nbsp; /p p strong Join the Team at Graphcore /strong /p p Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. /p p As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. /p p Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. /p p If you want to explore how complex AI systems really behave, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join the Systems Engineering team. /p Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
